sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
facts: Supercell labels Electro Fangs a Passive Ability for Dragon Duke and describes its attack chain.

equipment_activation_type.note: Primary release note explicitly labels the ability Passive; supplemental raw level fields remain unchanged.
